author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before: oval wings crossed the body so it read as a Theta, and the antennae were blobby hooks. Now: a wide upright body with two stripes and a round tail, semicircular wings attached to both body walls, and two antennae curling outward from the head corners, mirrored about x=24.
omissions: Stinger and the scalloped wing edges.
